correctness.rationale: For H>=2 the two inverse branches S0=x/H, S1=1-x/H contract with disjoint cylinder interiors (the H=2 shared boundary has zero Bernoulli mass). Every length-n word has one fixed point, distinct across words, with 2^-n per cylinder, so one-dimensional monotone optimal coupling matches each cylinder’s mass to its periodic fixed point. W1=H^-n E|X-Y_n|. Affine-branch sign average computes exact census barycenter m_n=(1-H^{-(2n-1)})/[2(1-H^{-2n})]. A self-similar absolute-deviation recurrence averaged over all fixed points permuted by f_H gives the stated exact W1 formula, including nonzero H^-3n correction; a jump at 0 yields exact Kolmogorov distance 2^-n. Independently recomputed rational periodic points and mean transport for n=1..3 at H=2,3,5/2. All-real H claim supported by algebra, not finite extrapolation.
